title: PCB Enclosure Design
summary: Full manufacturing drawing package for a PCB enclosure, built from revolve and extrude features to GD&T-ready detail.
problem: I struggled with optimising weight to ensure an efficient product was designed.
solution: I chose to proceed with lighter plastic PVC given its poor electrical conductivity to prevent short-circuit of electrical components.

title: Helical Gear Design
summary: Design and analysis of a helical gear system for efficient power transmission.
problem: Design a helical gear system for efficient power transmission, considering factors like load capacity, efficiency, and manufacturability.
solution: Performed detailed design  using SolidWorks, optimizing the gear geometry for the required torque and speed ratios while ensuring proper meshing and load distribution.

title: Sheet Metal Electronic Enclosure
summary: Design and assembly of a sheet metal electronic enclosure for efficient thermal management and electromagnetic shielding.
problem: Design a sheet metal electronic enclosure that provides efficient thermal management and electromagnetic shielding.
solution: Modelled the enclosure as a single part, applied cosmetic threads to the mounting holes, and mated the assembly with a press-fit relationship before producing a full drawing set.

title: SolidWorks Parametric Automation (Python + COM API)
summary: Python scripts driving SolidWorks' COM API to batch-update parametric dimensions across families of parts.
problem: Manually updating parametric dimensions across variant parts was slow and error-prone. The goal was to drive SolidWorks directly from Python to make configuration changes repeatable.
solution: Used pywin32 to bind to the SolidWorks COM API, working through a series of environment and binding issues to reliably open documents, edit dimensions and rebuild models from a script — turning a manual, repetitive task into a one-command operation.

title: NEO-6M GPS Rocket Recovery System
summary: Arduino-based GPS recovery beacon for hobby rocketry, transmitting live position after apogee for fast payload recovery.
problem: Recovering a rocket airframe after flight is difficult without live location data, especially over open terrain with dense vegetation.
solution: Built a lightweight recovery module around a NEO-6M GPS module and Arduino, logging and transmitting position data through descent so the airframe could be tracked and recovered quickly after landing.

title: Structural Analysis Dashboard
summary: A React web app for beam deflection, SFD/BMD, torsion, stress analysis, section properties and a material library.
problem: Quick structural checks during design iteration usually meant switching to a spreadsheet or hand calculation, breaking flow.
solution: Built a dark, engineering-styled dashboard covering beam deflection, shear force and bending moment diagrams, torsion, stress analysis and cross-section properties, backed by a built-in material library — combining calculation rigor with fast, visual iteration.

title: Pedal-Actuated Locking Lever (Practice Mechanism)
summary: A deliberate practice project in original linkage design, built to close a portfolio gap around mechanism synthesis.
problem: Client-style mechanism design briefs require confident, from-scratch linkage synthesis — a skill best sharpened outside of billable client time.
solution: Designed a foot-pedal-actuated locking lever from first principles, validating the motion path and locking geometry in SolidWorks Motion before detailing the final assembly.

title: ESP32 IoT Automation Node
summary: A Wi-Fi connected sensor/actuator node built around the ESP32 for remote monitoring and control.
problem: Needed a compact, reliable node to monitor sensor data and drive an actuator remotely without a dedicated gateway device.
solution: Built firmware around the ESP32's built-in Wi-Fi, publishing sensor readings and accepting commands over MQTT for lightweight, low-latency remote control.
